title: listing.yaml: what the Actuaria Market Place shows of a free dataset version
description: The written half of a listing. The rest (the task count, each project's count, the licence id, the registry) is read from the dataset itself into listing.json by scripts/listing.py.

domain.description: the field, as a reader names it: Coding

group.description: the group the Actuaria Market Place and Actuaria Studio Essentials file it under, one of their six (node-q/hbench assets/catalog/domains.json)

format.description: how an answer is checked: tests run on the work, or every field of a JSON answer is compared with the answer key

status.description: draft: nobody who does this work for a living has reviewed the answers yet (the Market Place says so, naming the trade)

trade.description: who would review it, in the plural: payroll specialists

sample_task.description: the task the Market Place shows (else the first by name)

licence.description: the licence as a reader reads it; its SPDX id comes from source.yaml

upstream.description: the work the dataset comes from, with credit

families.description: the kinds of work: one entry, as no task names its own kind, or one per kind when tasks.json records each task's

lines.description: repository: count the tasks by the repository their name starts with (owner__repo-<number>)
